name: Belmond Sanctuary Lodge
insider_take: The only hotel at the gates of Machu Picchu, where ancient Incan whispers meet luxury hospitality in the clouds.
whats_special: This is literally the only accommodation located at the entrance to Machu Picchu citadel, meaning you can walk to the ruins in minutes while other visitors take hour-long bus rides from Aguas Calientes. The hotel sits at 8,000 feet above sea level, offering unparalleled sunrise views over the ancient Incan ruins without the crowds.
pro_tip: Book the earliest possible Machu Picchu entry slot - you'll have the ruins virtually to yourself for magical golden hour photography before the day-trip crowds arrive via train from Cusco.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive access to Huayna Picchu mountain trail permits (limited to 400 people daily) and their guided dawn walks through the ruins. The Tampu Restaurant serves locally-sourced Peruvian cuisine with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Sacred Valley - dine while watching condors soar between the peaks.
pros: Only hotel located directly at Machu Picchu entrance
Exclusive access to early morning sunrise viewing
Luxury Belmond service and amenities in UNESCO World Heritage setting
No need for daily train travel to access the ruins
cons: Limited dining and entertainment options due to isolation
